_comment: Third-party modules the services import but the buyer app does not ship. Each needs a reason. bundle_imports.py skips these; anything else the services import must be in requirements-lock.txt.
pyautogui: Vision Mouse scroll and screen size (skills/mouse_control.py, lazy); pyautogui pulls mouseinfo (GPLv3+)
mlx_lm: cookbook model probe (codec_cookbook/probe.py); the cookbook is not in the bundle yet (audit P-012)
faster_whisper: optional local dictation model; PyAV's wheel bundles GPL libx264/libx265, so dictation uses the whisper-stt server
fitz: PDF text in codec.py document input; PyMuPDF is AGPL-3.0
key_value.aio.stores.disk: fallback token store in skills/mcp_connect.py used only when the Keychain store fails; needs diskcache and pathvalidate, which are not in the lock (every Mac has a Keychain)
